items.criterion: The new assignee is stored on the issue after a lead assigns it.
items.judgment: Read the issue and confirm the assignee equals the assigned member.

items.criterion: Exactly one notification email reaches the assignee on assignment.
items.judgment: Read the mail service and confirm one message to the assignee with the assignment subject.

items.criterion: A member moving an issue it does not own is refused.
items.judgment: Send the move as a non-owner member and confirm a client-error refusal.

items.criterion: A cross-team issue read is answered as not found.
items.judgment: Request another team's issue and confirm a not-found answer.

items.criterion: At most one cycle per team is active.
items.judgment: Read the cycles and confirm a single active cycle for the team.

items.criterion: Two concurrent activations of a second cycle resolve to one winner.
items.judgment: Race two activations and confirm one success and one conflict.

items.criterion: A replayed create-issue request creates no second issue.
items.judgment: Replay the request with the same client request id and confirm one issue.

items.criterion: A state change writes one matching activity record.
items.judgment: Move an issue and confirm an activity record accompanies the new state.

items.criterion: Closing a cycle returns unfinished issues to the inbox and reports the count.
items.judgment: Close the active cycle and confirm the reported count matches the returned issues.

items.criterion: Every issue key in a team is distinct and never reused.
items.judgment: File issues under contention and confirm every key is unique.
